description: Starts a new webinar in WebinarIgnition and returns the first question with tappable options — no sign-in, no setup. Side effect: it creates a new webinar session on the connector and returns a `session_id`; nothing is written to a WordPress site, nothing is published and no email is sent. `situation` takes the host's own words, `known_facts` what is already known (topic, audience, offer, tone); with either, the conversation opens at that point instead of an empty menu. The reply carries a `session_id` for `wi_continue_webinar`.

has_wi.description: true when WebinarIgnition is already installed on the host's site.

has_wordpress.description: true when the host already has a WordPress site. Reist als Fluss-Signal mit: ohne es gilt der Standardweg (der Host hat vermutlich WordPress). Mit false wird der Verbinden-Schritt in der Strecke uebersprungen.

known_facts.description: Everything you already know — send it every turn so nothing is lost on a restart. On the FIRST call (this call or this call) this is how a chat/assistant hands over what it already learned about the host (topic, audience, offer, style/tone) instead of making them repeat it.

language.description: The language the host writes in.

situation.description: Only with this call or this call: what the host just said, in their own words. On this call this also starts a real conversation (seeded with known_facts) instead of only showing the menu — use it when the host already wrote something about their webinar.

name: wi_start_webinar
title: Start a webinar
